section_summary.extract_value: This section details the procedure of an experiment. Participants completed premeasures for goal orientation and cognitive ability, then learned rules for an air defense task. They were randomly assigned to either a constant or variable practice condition, practiced the task for 48 trials, and then completed a self-efficacy measure before being tested on a transfer task.
